title: «Словники України» online
usedFor: Independent check of stress in the dictionary of the Academy of Sciences institute: мо́ва, приві́т, вода́, ха́та, поба́чення, ла́ска all agree with Горох.
notes: Based on the 2008 CD version 3.2. A search for дякувати first returns the homograph дякува́ти (дяку́ю), not дя́кувати (to thank). Discrepancy found: accusative singular of вода is воду́ here but во́ду in Горох (unresolved; only the nominative вода́ is used in the conventions).
